summary: Natuzzi S.p.A., the NYSE-listed Italian furniture maker, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) solely to announce the timing of its unaudited 2026 second-quarter financial information, to be disclosed Wednesday October 21, 2026, with a related conference call Thursday October 22, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern (16:00 CET). No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. The filing is a routine earnings-calendar notice; no special-situation or risk-arb angle applies.
